{"code": "from IPython.display import display

# Preprocess revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify no NaNs now
print('Number of NaN in revenue_clean:')
print(df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())

# Now filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Display the result
print(f'\nMean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')

# Show the count for context
print(f'Number of completed LOYAL orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')"}
